scope: Cover, README presentation, showcase and existing automated product regression. No new live translation or Zotero-host test.

cover.typography: DengXian regular for Chinese display text; Segoe UI / Microsoft YaHei for supporting copy
cover.imageGeneration: Built-in image_gen; referenced existing reading-desk.webp; photographic retouch only; lettering is real browser text

checks: Desktop headline stays on two deliberate lines
Theme switches light to dark and back
Network lookup renders an actual definition
Dictionary switching updates the displayed definition
Annotation demo discloses that it does not persist
Legacy homepage preserves query and fragment
Click switch changes without changing selection switch
Self-contained file HTML loads a definition
Loaded 320px demo has no horizontal overflow
Narrow demo moves image above definition instead of squeezing text
notes: The verification script initially waited for a lazy-loaded mobile result before scrolling it into view; scrolling into view correctly loaded it. This was a test-order issue.
A real visual issue was found in the synthetic mobile demo: its floating illustration squeezed the definition into short lines. The demo dictionary stylesheet now stacks the image below 400px.
Existing live-translation evidence and v1.3.0 XPI are retained unchanged.
screenshotCapture: Final site snapshots await document.fonts.ready and image.decode() for every image before capture.
